name: Greenhouse
source:
You're a lone anthro dragon tasked with finding 3 missing college friends. To do so, you'll have to traverse a massive plant research facility filled with kinky flora dangers poised on making you theirs.

[From [url=https://ekull.itch.io/greenhouse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一只孤独的人类龙，肩负着寻找3名失踪大学朋友的任务。为此，你必须穿越一个巨大的植物研究设施，里面充满了奇异的植物危险，随时准备将你变成他们的。

[来自[url=https://ekull.itch.io/greenhouse]Itch.io[/url]]
